scope: Improve Vorax, Tartarus and especially Arcana decisions; establish reliable Arcana capture and verify full release without regressions.
captureChanges: Arcana requests Windows Graphics Capture first through a window-scoped one-shot mode in the existing Rust executable; Vorax adviser behavior is unchanged.
Each capture session is closed after returning a frame. Cancellation and timeouts kill owned capture children.
Changing the active game HWND retires the old Arcana worker and its checkpoint.
evidence: Rust Vorax engine/adviser/Smart parity and scan/round/continuation tests passed during backend rebuild.
43 source check groups passed, including GPU protocol/cancellation and real GPU-window capture.
Owned WebGL window changed colors twice; the second update was correctly captured behind an owned black cover.
Actual unpacked application captured saved game pixels from an owned window using Windows Graphics Capture, read the complete hand/die/life and produced solver advice after initial path confirmation.
Normal Arcana packaged lifecycle/correction/overlay test passed.
remaining: Check forced Chromium fallback and full packaged suite after final edits.
